content_universe: Same Pixel & Ink Studio universe. The Mission: Andrés presents the bakery brief decisions ORALLY to Sophia in a simulated 3-minute client-briefing rehearsal. Variants: presenting to the real client (La Esquina), onboarding a new junior designer, help-desk triage for a color question.

pm0_anchor.feedback_mode_dominant: Recast during rehearsal + Explicit correction on pronunciation + Acceptance of fluency errors during free production
success_factors_applied: Salience (pronunciation cards with IPA + stress dots + minimal pairs)
Use (productive speaking task with verifiable outcome)
Emotion (low-stakes rehearsal → supportive partner → graded performance)

universe_anchor.mission_core_scenario: ANDRÉS BRIEFS SOPHIA — 3-minute oral presentation where Andrés (learner) presents his brief decisions to Sophia (partner), who asks 2 follow-up questions.
universe_anchor.information_gap_genuine: Sophia (partner A) has a questionnaire with 5 slots to fill based on Andrés's speech. Andrés (partner B) has his Design Decision Card. Sophia must extract info; Andrés must provide it clearly.
universe_anchor.deliverable: Completed Sophia Questionnaire Sheet + audio recording (optional) + instructor observation checklist
mission_variants: Variant 1 (default): Andrés briefs Sophia on La Esquina Bakery
Variant 2: Andrés onboards a new junior designer — explains color wheel
Variant 3: Andrés runs help-desk — answers color question from intern
Variant 4: Andrés presents to the REAL client (La Esquina owner) — adds formality
universe_anchor.time_per_student: 3 min speaking + 2 min follow-up Q&A = 5 min per student (evidence window)

pronunciation_scaffolding_integrated_fro.note: PM-2.7 was deprecated in v2.0. Pronunciation scaffolding is now embedded in PM-2.8 PRE phase.

trabalenguas_tecnicos_tongue_twisters.phrase: Warm brown, cool blue, warm brown, cool blue
Round logo, bold logo, round bold logo

trabalenguas_tecnicos_tongue_twisters.phrase: CMYK values, RGB values, print-ready values

fonemas_problematicos_for_ES_learners.studio_example: We FIT the logo vs We meet the FEET

fonemas_problematicos_for_ES_learners.studio_example: A flat rack for the artBAG
The SHIP of the bakery CHIPS

prosody_and_rhythm_practice.sentence_stress_rule: CONTENT words (nouns, verbs, adjectives) carry stress. FUNCTION words (a, the, is, for, and) are reduced.
prosody_and_rhythm_practice.example_marked: the FONT is PLAYFAIR DISPLAY — a CLASSIC SERIF.
prosody_and_rhythm_practice.physical_exercise: Clap on content words; whisper function words.

shadowing_chunks_to_rehearse: The brief is for La Esquina Bakery.
The font is Playfair Display — a classic serif.
The colors are brown and cream.
The logo is a round seal.

ear_training_in_context.exercise: Listen to Sophia's voice note again (from PM-2.6). For each chunk, mark stressed syllables. Compare with your own speech.
ear_training_in_context.self_correction_loop: Record self → play back → compare to Sophia → re-record

bilingual_unified_header.english: THE MISSION — 3 minutes. You are Andrés. You present your brief decisions. Sophia listens. Make your voice count.
bilingual_unified_header.spanish_italics: (3 minutos. Eres Andrés. Presentas tus decisiones. Sophia escucha. Haz que tu voz cuente.)
bilingual_unified_header.motivational_hook: You already WROTE the email. You already HEARD the voice note. Now SPEAK it.

mission_brief.title: 🎯 MISSION BRIEF — The Bakery Briefing
mission_brief.scenario: Tuesday, 11 AM at Pixel & Ink Studio. Sophia has 3 minutes before her next meeting. Andrés must brief her on La Esquina Bakery NOW. Get all 5 decisions across clearly.
mission_brief.communication_rule: English ONLY. If you don't know a word, DESCRIBE it or USE the Toolbelt chart. No Spanish except emergency.
mission_brief.deliverable: Sophia's Questionnaire Sheet completed correctly (≥4 of 5 slots) + your voice audible to the whole partnership
failure_modes_to_avoid: Reading from the email (this is SPEAKING, not reading aloud)
Using Spanish more than 3 times (L1% = 15% max)
Finishing in under 90 seconds (too rushed) or over 4 min (too slow)

archetypes_integrated.policy: ALL 5 archetypes A-E are documented. Instructor picks ONE flow for the S4 Speaking block (50-80 min depending on class size and variant).
archetypes_integrated.spanish: (TODOS los 5 arquetipos documentados. Instructor elige UN flujo.)

archetype_A_gap_tasks.name: Gap Tasks (Information / Reasoning / Opinion)
archetype_A_gap_tasks.when_it_works: When genuine info gap creates real need to communicate; TBLT gold standard.

activities.phase: PRE — Pronunciation Warmup + Role Card Setup (15 min)
activities.instruction_bilingual: 10 min pronunciation drill (tongue twisters + minimal pairs). 5 min get your role card. (*10 min drill de pronunciación. 5 min recibe tu tarjeta de rol.*)
activities.pronunciation_drills: All 4 tongue twisters from pronunciation_scaffolding_integrated above + 3 minimal pairs

role_cards.has: Design Decision Card with 5 slots filled
Blank Questionnaire Sheet with 5 empty slots
role_cards.mission: Fill all 5 slots + ask 2 follow-up questions

activities.phase: DURING — The 3-Minute Briefing (25 min: 5 pairs × 5 min rotating)
activities.instruction_bilingual: Partner A briefs. Partner B fills questionnaire. Swap. (*A informa. B llena cuestionario. Intercambien.*)

sophia_questionnaire_5_slots.expected: The bakery is a family shop; warm colors feel friendly

sophia_followup_questions_must_ask_2: How do you feel about [color choice]?
What is the [logo] in one word?
activities.reasoning_gap_bonus: After briefing, Sophia decides: APPROVE or ASK FOR REVISION. Justify in 1 sentence.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Compare questionnaires. Count correct slots. Reflect. (*Comparen cuestionarios. Cuenten slots correctos. Reflexionen.*)
reflection_prompts: Which of the 5 decisions was easiest to say?
Did your partner hear everything? Why / why not?
What will I practice before next time?

archetype_B_role_based.name: Role-Based Speaking (Professional Simulation)
archetype_B_role_based.when_it_works: When the genre is workplace-authentic; when the role gives learner ownership.
archetype_B_role_based.fit_for_A1_1: High — role masks performance anxiety behind character.

activities.instruction_bilingual: 10 min: pronunciation drill + sound check. 5 min: study your role card. (*10 min drill pronunciación + check. 5 min estudia tu rol.*)

role_cards_with_studio_identity.identity: 6 months at Pixel & Ink. Works on La Esquina Bakery brief.
role_cards_with_studio_identity.speech_patterns: Friendly, slightly nervous, uses 'I think' + 'My decision is'

activities.phase: DURING — The Studio Meeting Simulation (25 min)
activities.instruction_bilingual: In groups of 3: Andrés + Sophia + Observer. 5 min rotation × 5 groups. (*Grupos de 3: Andrés + Sophia + Observador. Rotación 5 min × 5 grupos.*)
activities.simulation_structure: Andrés briefs (90 sec) → Sophia asks 2 questions (60 sec) → Andrés responds (60 sec) → Observer gives feedback (30 sec)

activities.instruction_bilingual: Rotate roles. Who had the hardest job? Who surprised themselves? (*Roten. ¿Quién tuvo el trabajo más difícil? ¿Quién se sorprendió a sí mismo?*)
activities.role_reflection: Being Andrés was different from being Sophia because _________. Being an Observer taught me _________.

archetype_C_multimedia_output.name: Multimedia Output (Podcast / Video / Recorded Pitch)
archetype_C_multimedia_output.when_it_works: When tech access available; when learners want their work preserved; great for MGV (design students love multimedia).
archetype_C_multimedia_output.tech_required: Smartphone with audio recording OR laptop with mic
archetype_C_multimedia_output.production_selected: Design Decision Monologue Podcast (90-second solo pitch)

activities.instruction_bilingual: Write your 90-sec pitch script. Practice pronunciation 3 times. (*Escribe tu pitch de 90 seg. Ensaya pronunciación 3 veces.*)
script_structure_6_slots: 1. [5 sec] INTRO: 'Hi, this is [name]. Today I talk about [client].'
2. [15 sec] CLIENT: 'My client is [name]. It's a [type]. They want [feeling].'
3. [15 sec] FONT DECISION: 'The font is [name]. I choose this because...'
4. [15 sec] COLOR DECISION: 'The colors are [X] and [Y]. [Warm/Cool] colors are...'
5. [15 sec] LOGO: 'The logo is a [shape] [object]. It shows...'
6. [15 sec] CLOSE: 'Thanks for listening. My next step is...'
activities.pronunciation_rehearsal: Record pre-take → listen → mark errors → re-record twice

activities.instruction_bilingual: Record 3 takes. Pick the best. (*Graba 3 tomas. Elige la mejor.*)

take_structure.take_2: Careful take — slow down, stress clear

activities.phase: POST — Gallery Listen + Peer Vote (10 min)
activities.instruction_bilingual: Upload to shared folder. Listen to 3 classmates. Vote. (*Sube a carpeta. Escucha 3. Vota.*)

archetype_D_rehearsal_scaffolding.name: Rehearsal & Scaffolding (Guided → Free)
archetype_D_rehearsal_scaffolding.when_it_works: When learners freeze in free speaking; progressive scaffold.
archetype_D_rehearsal_scaffolding.fit_for_A1_1: Highest — ideal archetype for first speaking task.
archetype_D_rehearsal_scaffolding.scaffolding_technique: Scaffolded Dialogue + Substitution Drill + Cue Cards → Free Production

activities.instruction_bilingual: Read the model dialogue. Practice with partner. (*Lee el diálogo modelo. Practica con compañero.*)

model_dialogue.andres: Hi Sophia. The brief is for La Esquina Bakery.
The font is Playfair Display. A classic serif.
The colors are brown and cream. Warm colors are friendly.
The logo is a round seal. A simple logo is the best logo.

activities.practice_rule: Read dialogue aloud 3 times with partner. Swap roles between reads.

activities.phase: DURING — Substitution Drill + Cue Card Free Production (25 min)
activities.instruction_bilingual: Substitute new client info. Then try WITHOUT the script — use only cue card. (*Sustituye datos nuevos. Luego intenta SIN guión — solo con tarjeta.*)

substitution_round_1.task: Redo the dialogue but for: 'Café Luna' (modern café, Montserrat font, black + gold, crescent moon logo)
substitution_round_1.scaffold: Full dialogue script visible; just change the 4 nouns

substitution_round_2.task: Redo for 'Nova Bookshop' (classic bookshop, Garamond font, navy + white, open book logo)
substitution_round_2.scaffold: Only cue card with 4 keywords visible

free_production_round_3.task: Your OWN invented client. 90 sec monologue + partner asks 2 questions.
free_production_round_3.scaffold: No script. Only Language Bank chunks visible on wall.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Rate your 3 rounds 1-5. What changed from Round 1 to Round 3? (*Puntúa tus 3 rondas 1-5. ¿Qué cambió?*)
activities.reflection_question: Did removing the scaffold make me more stressed or more creative?

archetype_E_interaction_dynamics.name: Interaction Dynamics (Mingle / Quiz / Interview / Spin-off)
archetype_E_interaction_dynamics.when_it_works: When energy is low; when multiple mini-interactions beat one long task.
archetype_E_interaction_dynamics.fit_for_A1_1: High — low stakes per interaction; lots of reps.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Drill 3 tongue twisters. Prepare 5 questions you'll ask. (*Drill 3 trabalenguas. Prepara 5 preguntas.*)
question_bank_scaffolded: Is the logo big or small?
Is your client modern or traditional?

activities.instruction_bilingual: 5 rotations × 5 min = brief 5 different partners. Fill scorecard. (*5 rotaciones × 5 min = informa a 5 compañeros diferentes. Llena scorecard.*)
activities.rotation_rule: 30 sec each direction. Instructor rings bell every minute.

activities.instruction_bilingual: Test what you remember. Ask 3 questions about 1 classmate's project. (*Test lo que recuerdas. Haz 3 preguntas sobre 1 proyecto.*)

rotation_options_for_instructor.policy: Instructor picks ONE flow for the S4 Speaking block.

flows.name: Scaffolded Safety (Recommended for first speaking task)
flows.sequence: Archetype D (Rehearsal & Scaffolding) — dialogue → substitution → free
flows.best_for: First formal speaking in the program; A1.1 anxiety management

flows.name: TBLT Gap Task (Recommended for G1 evidence)
flows.sequence: Archetype A (Gap Tasks) — information gap with questionnaire

flows.name: Workplace Roleplay
flows.best_for: Groups of 3; observer role builds metacognition

flows.name: Podcast Production
flows.best_for: Tech-enabled classes; preserved artifact; great for MGV portfolio

flows.name: High-Energy Mingle
flows.sequence: Archetype E (Interaction Dynamics) — speed briefing 5 rotations
flows.best_for: Low energy groups; lots of reps; volume-based fluency

flows.name: Maximalist Hybrid (D→A→C)
flows.sequence: 15min Scaffolding warmup → 25min Gap Task evidence → 10min Record 30-sec clip
flows.best_for: Extended 60-min block; covers safety + evidence + artifact

rotation_options_for_instructor.recommended_default_for_G1: FLOW-S1 (Rehearsal & Scaffolding) for initial safety → instructor can upgrade to FLOW-S2 (Gap Task) for evidence capture. Or combine D→A as FLOW-S6 hybrid.

cue_card_for_learner.title: 📇 ANDRÉS CUE CARD — Pocket Reference
cue_card_for_learner.instruction_bilingual: Keep this card. Use during rehearsal. Put away during evidence round. (*Guarda esta tarjeta. Úsala en ensayo. Guárdala en la ronda de evidencia.*)
cue_card_for_learner.mission_reminder: Brief Sophia on the bakery. 3 minutes. English only.
5_must_say_chunks: The brief is for La Esquina Bakery.
The font is ________ — a classic serif.

instructor_observation_guide.title: 👁️ INSTRUCTOR'S OBSERVATION GUIDE — E4 Speaking (5 pts)
instructor_observation_guide.instrument: Escala de Estimación No 4 (Rating Scale per PM-4.1 canon)

observation_criteria.description: Partner understands ≥4 of 5 decisions without repetition
Correctly applies be + a/an + adjective position
observation_criteria.score_2: No significant errors in target structures
All Survival Words clearly pronounced; word stress correct
observation_criteria.score_1: Most Survival Words pronounced; some stress errors

observation_criteria.description: Maintains interaction; responds to questions; uses closings
observation_criteria.score_2: Smooth interaction; greets + closes; responds to both follow-ups

instructor_observation_guide.score_conversion: Total possible: 10 pts (5 criteria × 2 pts). Divide by 2 → final score out of 5.

A1_1: Spanish loan words (brief = briefing sometimes OK)

plan_B_if_learner_freezes: Instructor provides first Language Bank chunk as prompt
Allow 5 seconds silence before stepping in
Switch to cue card visible mode (-1 pt max)
In worst case: convert to recorded pitch (asynchronous, Archetype C)

feedback.dominant_mode: Recast during rehearsal + Explicit correction on pronunciation + Accept fluency errors during free production
accuracy_techniques: Pronunciation correction via minimal pairs warm-up
Recast on Gr4 word order errors (learner says 'colors warm' → teacher recasts 'yes, warm colors')
Shadowing of PM-2.6 chunks builds prosodic accuracy

l1_management.english_zone: Activated fully during evidence round; relaxed slightly during rehearsal
legitimate_L1_uses: Emergency when partner is stuck — single word fallback

physical_techniques: Clap on stressed syllable during pronunciation warmup
Body lean forward on stressed word
Whisper unstressed function words (a, the, is)
stress_pronunciation.board_marking: Stressed syllable marked with big dot; minimal pair contrasts in 2 columns

factors_applied.Connection: Every term already seen in Reading, Vocab, Listening
factors_applied.Emotion: Rehearsal + partner support = low stress evidence
factors_applied.Synergy: Speaking consolidates all prior input; vocab is now ACTIVE not just passive

integration_all_archetypes_policy.rationale: Per Sergio's directive (2026-04-20): 'Quiero todos los arquetipos para todos los PM.' All 5 Speaking archetypes documented.
integration_all_archetypes_policy.recommended_default_for_G1: FLOW-S1 (Scaffolding) for safety → FLOW-S2 (Gap Task) for evidence. Hybrid D→A optimal.
integration_all_archetypes_policy.workbook_use: Each archetype populates one Workbook speaking extension activity.

activities.statement: Participar en simulación oral de 3 minutos presentando decisiones de diseño (fuente + paleta + logo + justificación) al rol de Art Director, usando ≥6 términos del Toolbelt, chunks del Manual de Supervivencia Oral y estructuras Gr1-Gr4 con pronunciación inteligible de las 5 Survival Words.

evidence.description: El aprendiz demuestra capacidad de comunicación oral en inglés ejecutando rol de Junior Designer en briefing simulado de 3 minutos, con pronunciación inteligible, uso productivo de vocabulario técnico, precisión gramatical en Gr1-Gr4 y adecuación pragmática al registro semi-formal de estudio de diseño.

environment.type: Aula (con espacios para simulaciones en pares/tríos)
materials: Tarjetas de rol con guiones técnicos (Andrés / Sophia / Observer)
Pronunciation guide con IPA + stress dots + minimal pairs
environment.instructors: Instructor de inglés técnico (observador primario durante evidencia)

activity_card.quiz_note: Speaking is evaluated LIVE via Escala de Estimación (observation). Does NOT contribute items to Cuestionario Consolidado S6. Its 5 pts are independent formative evidence E4.

ambiente_learning.configuration: Pares o tríos distribuidos en el aula; espacios semi-privados para evidencia
ambiente_learning.equipment: Cronómetro visible + Word Wall + Pronunciation board + Cue cards
ambiente_learning.conditions: Acústica aceptable para oír claramente entre pares; minimizar ruido cruzado

estrategia_didactica.justificacion: S4 consolida todas las habilidades previas en producción oral. La Mission es el punto de integración donde vocabulary + grammar + listening model + pronunciation scaffolding se manifiestan en habla real con propósito comunicativo verificable.

cognitiva_saber.objeto: vocabulario técnico del Toolbelt (≥6 términos productivos) y chunks del Manual de Supervivencia Oral
cognitiva_saber.condicion: en contexto de briefing simulado con presión temporal de 3 minutos

procedimental_hacer.objeto: briefing oral completo con 5 decisiones técnicas + 2 respuestas a preguntas follow-up
procedimental_hacer.condicion: usando Gr1-Gr4 correctamente, pronunciando inteligiblemente las 5 Survival Words y manteniendo registro semi-formal

actitudinal_ser.objeto: rol profesional de Junior Designer con confianza y apertura a feedback
actitudinal_ser.condicion: respetando normas de turno conversacional, mostrando tolerancia a errores propios/pares y usando frases de emergencia cuando sea necesario sin caer en español
